summary_md: **Machine Delusions ([@Machinedelusion](https://x.com/Machinedelusion/status/2116668287656333409))** highlights Tencent's Apache-2.0 **WeVisCut**, a 9B tool-using agent that turns a script into a multi-minute edited video (shots, voiceover, footage, music) and checks and fixes its own cut, reportedly matching Claude Opus 5 at about 33x fewer tokens ([Tencent/WeVisCut](https://github.com/Tencent/WeVisCut), [project page](https://tencent.github.io/WeVisCut/)).
